newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Aug 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Aug 28.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi Defence Minister Prince Sultan visits Yemen on Wednesday to settle border dispute between the two countries.
- Dallah Group wins $186 million Saudi deal to maintain Mecca and holy shrines for five years.
- A Joint Egyptian-Kuwaiti ministerial committee is to meet to discuss cooperation in setting up projects.
- Yemen tells the Security Council it is committed to an agreement in principle with Eritrea over disputed islands.
- Kuwaiti parliament ratifies a new industry law allowing residents of Gulf Arab states to establish firms.
